Week's standout coverage: Warrior Sports founder's $12M Cherry Hills mansion listing, Lakewood's tallest office tower selling at 30% discount, Englewood romance bookstore opening. Current week's +14 gain vs prior period confirms media attention rebuilding after spring drought, with luxury real estate and local business launches driving Father's Day weekend traffic.
